scenario: [LTIE.4.9]: the compiler must refuse a `retain:` kwarg on a `publish` with DS_VALIDATE_PUBLISH_MODIFIER: nothing in the publishing tier would carry the lifetime ([LTIE.4.3]), and the receiving schema gives the fact its own ([LTIE.9.4]). The program enables `dynamic_ttl`, so the `retain:` is no capability refusal, and rule `r` writes `publish Out k: t.k retain: 5_s` into a `ttl` schema, where an `emit` takes the override ([LDTL.4.1]). PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s `ltie_4_9_publish_modifier`, from `lgra_10_3_2_action`, on the kwarg.
rules_ds:
use default:
    dynamic_ttl: true

schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key

schema Out scope ttl 1_h:
    k: Int

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    publish Out k: t.k retain: 5_s
